newsitem.title: USA: Intrenet names Roger Burbage CFO.
newsitem.headline: Intrenet names Roger Burbage CFO.

text.p: Intrenet Inc Monday said it named Roger Burbage, most recently president of Landstar Poole Inc, chief financial officer.

Burbage replaces Jonathan Usher, who was named a senior vice president and will retain his current titles as treasurer and secretary. The appointment of Usher reflects a broadening of his responsibilities into areas including new business development, acquisitions and assisting subsidiary companies with the design and development of cost-control programs, Intrenet said.

"With the appointment of Roger Burbage to CFO, I believe that Intrenet is building a strong and creative management team that carries with it the kind of industry and financial experience necessary to achieve profitability," said John Delavan, president and chief executive officer of Intrenet.

He added that "as difficult as 1996 was for Intrenet and for the trucking industry overall, I believe there is a turnaround under way at Intrenet. We have aggressively cut costs while at the same time growing our revenue base. Our first quarter revenues continue to reflect a strong growth and I believe 1997 will be profitable for Intrenet."
